feeds.title: Campark Blog
feeds.description: Experience camping on the edge of the countryside of beautiful Niagara Falls, Ontario, Canada. The lush landscape and historical landmark location have been transformed into Niagara's premier family camping destination.

feeds.title: Traversing
feeds.description: Traversing offers Canadian camping and canoeing news, tips, and gear reviews. We publish daily blog posts and always welcome your feedback. We love to share what Canada has to offer!

feeds.title: Camp Abegweit Blog
feeds.description: Camp Abegweit is a faith based camp, supported by the United Church of Canada through PEI congregations and Fundy St Lawrence Dawning Waters Region.

feeds.title: Camp Kintail Blog
feeds.description: Camp Kintail is a Presbyterian summer camp responsible for the Synod of Southwestern Ontario. Kintail provides a friendly and fun Christian community for children of all ages, from 0 to 100!

feeds.title: Gone Camping Blog
feeds.description: We are a family of four deeply in love with nature. We spend all our free time exploring it, embracing its beauty, and doing our best to preserve and protect it. This blog is about our adventures, big and small.

feeds.title: Camp Fircom Blog
feeds.description: Located on Gambier Island in British Columbia, Canada, Camp Fircom curates outdoor BC summer camp programming that focuses on providing unique experiences to participants. We celebrate the outdoors and an outdoor lifestyle and encourage participants to find time to relax in the fresh air of our 120-acre waterfront property.

feeds.title: Riverbend Campground Blog
feeds.description: Riverbend is a family campground with everything you need for an enjoyable stay. Family in central to everything we do. We are family owned and operated and we are a kid friendly campground. Our unique location on the banks of the Sheep River encompasses a diversity of habitats: parkland, marshland, and river

feeds.title: Stoney Lake Bible Camp Blog
feeds.description: Stoney Lake Bible Camp offers a professionally run camping program. Our trained staff provides 24 hour supervision and it is our goal to give your camper an unforgettable camping experience. Our program provides the opportunity for campers to experience many new activities.

feeds.title: Una chica y su caballo
feeds.description: Camping and riding across Canada. The blog was created so that the author could jot down her experiences on what was going to be a road trip to remember: a coast-to-coast trip, and back again.

feeds.title: Kamp Kiwanis Blog
feeds.description: The Kiwanis Club of Calgary owns and operates Kamp Kiwanis Calgary located near Bragg Creek, Alberta, Canada. We offer a summer camp program and rental facilities with over 250 beds, dining facilities, and meeting spaces.

feeds.title: Bayview Glen Camp Blog
feeds.description: Bayview Glen Camp offers wide-ranging and well-balanced programs to give campers plenty of choices and opportunities to learn, grow and express themselves.

feeds.title: Big Daddy Kreativ » RVing and Camping
feeds.description: Big Daddy Kreativ's blog specializes in travel, food, lifestyle, automotive, parenting, events, health, giveaways, and reviews.

feeds.title: This Big Adventure » Camp
feeds.description: We believe adventure can start the moment you step out your front door. From exploring our hometown, taking day trips, weekend camping excursions, or long haul vacations, we love to do it all! Stick around as we set you up with all the tips, tricks, and hidden gems that we find along the way!

feeds.title: Sail Blog » Camping
feeds.description: Do you enjoy spending time outdoors even in chilly weather? Do you dream of being surrounded by breathtaking fall colours while camping in the heart of the forest, but are afraid of being cold? Find out how to equip yourself for a successful stay in the great outdoors that you will remember for a long time.

feeds.title: Altitude Blog » Camping
feeds.description: Discover expert advice on the best camping gear out there. Find in-depth buying guides, product reviews, and new discoveries. At Altitude Sports, we offer you a review of the best camping tents, we explain how to choose your sleeping bag, and we have a go at winter camping. Benefit from the expert advice of our professionals for all your camping needs.

feeds.title: Campground Reservations Blog
feeds.description: Our mission at Camp Reservations Canada is to connect Campers with Campground Operators through our online platform. We strive to make selecting and booking a campsite simple, so you can start your adventure!

feeds.title: Campertunity Blog
feeds.description: Discover amazing campsites through Campertunity's network of exclusive campgrounds. Or, rent your beautiful land to our new network of campers.

feeds.title: InterVarsity Pioneer Camp Ontario Blog
feeds.description: Browse our blog for up to date information on our Christian summer camp programs and ways your children can benefit from this experience. Pioneer Camp is a Christian summer camp and Outdoor Education and Retreat Centre offering programs for children, youth, and students located in Muskoka, Ontario.

feeds.title: Kids Who Explore » Camping with Kids
feeds.description: Camping trips provide family memories for many years to come! We hope to inspire you to go on that camping trip and connect in nature together.Kids Who Explore is a Social Enterprise comprised of explorers who value spending time in the outdoors.
